# StudyRaid

> > AI-powered learning platform combining personalized tutoring, course generation, and study tools for modern education.

StudyRaid is an intelligent learning platform that leverages AI to create personalized educational experiences through courses, quizzes, flashcards, and certification programs. The platform enables both learners to master subjects efficiently and educators to generate courses at scale.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered learning
- Personalized education
- AI tutoring
- Course generation
- Spaced repetition
- Flashcards & quizzes
- Certification programs
- Study tools
- Course creation
- Student onboarding
- Subject directory
- Quiz generation
- Learning platform
- Student testimonials

## Platform Overview

- [StudyRaid Homepage](https://app.studyraid.com/en): Main landing page featuring AI-powered learning platform with courses, quizzes, exams, and onboarding
- [StudyRaid Root](http://app.studyraid.com/): Primary entry point with AI tutoring, flashcards, and student onboarding features
- [Main Platform](https://app.studyraid.com/?page=14): Core platform interface with AI course creation, certification tools, and learning management

## Learning Resources

- [Course Categories](https://app.studyraid.com/en/categories): Browsable directory of course categories and subject areas for discovering learning content
